content: Ridley Scott is one of those staple filmmakers. The 88-year-old English director has made countless noteworthy films, TV shows, and commercials over the course of his prolific career, dabbling in so many genres that it’s difficult to narrow down the parameters of his work. With the release of this year’s The Dog Stars, Scott has directed 31 feature films. They don’t all share the same characteristics, but broadly, his films are known for huge and immersive sets, battles on an epic scale, and big and heady concepts.
